name: almanac
description: Agent memory as an Obsidian vault of verified rules, with hooks that gate shell commands and make sessions write what they learn.

vault.title: Obsidian vault
vault.description: Folder of the Obsidian vault. Each project's memory lives in a subfolder named after its repository.

gate_mode.title: Gate mode
gate_mode.description: off: no gate. shadow: hard rules apply, classifier decisions are only logged. enforce: classifier decisions apply too.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Optional. Turns on the classifier for the gate, the Stop hook and triage. Command text is sent to TypeSafe when set.
